messages:
elena_sales: Quick thread — AtlasCare wants a 4-week POC for med-qa-7b-v2 on Private. Requirements: SentencePiece (32k), CMEK HSM, int4 quant, UI latency target p50 <=150ms at 1-2 concurrent sessions. Who's picking this up?
drew_se: I can own model compatibility checks. First ask: do they have a canonical tokenizer export (.spm + vocab)? Need byte-level parity. Also what sampling/heurstic seeds used in training?
elena_sales: They can provide the .spm and a 200-prompt sample. I'll request it. Also they asked if we support key rotation with no downtime.
morgan_compliance: Short answer for questionnaire: "Redwood Private supports customer-managed keys (CMEK) integrated with major KMS providers including HSM-backed stores. Customers control rotation cadence; rotation may trigger a brief endpoint reload (<30s) if keys are replaced. We do not persist plaintext customer keys. Audit logs for inference and admin actions can be exported to customer SIEM and retention configured. SOC2 Type II summary available under NDA." Use that in the form.
pavel_infra: Running an infra sweep. Main risk is int4 + KV-cache interaction causing tiny distribution shifts -> potential clinical answer drift. My plan: run int4 vs fp16 canary, tokenizer parity diff, and perf harness at seq=128 and seq=512, conc=1-2. Will collect p50/p95 and perplexity delta vs fp16 baseline.
elena_sales: Any ballpark on pricing delta for the POC (4 weeks)? They want a single quote including infra + 10 support hours.
pavel_infra: Ballpark: quantized Dedicated tier usually ~30-40% lower infra cost vs fp16 at similar latency. For a short POC include a small dedicated pool + reserved support hours. Ill give a concrete number after the sweep.
drew_se: Test config I'm going to run: ```model: med-qa-7b-v2
variants: [int4, fp16_canary]
tokenizer: sentencepiece-32k (canonical .spm)
seqs: [128,512]
concurrency: [1,2]
metrics: [p50_latency, p95_latency, perplexity_delta, tokenization_mismatch_count]```
elena_sales: please also check tail-latency on cold starts and when keys rotate. They specifically worried about reload windows.
pavel_infra: Noted. Adding cold-start and key-rotation reload to the harness.
ops_bot: Ticket created: RINF-11824 — "AtlasCare med-qa-7b-v2 Private POC: tokenizer/quant/CMEK validation". Assignee: pavel_infra. ETA: 72h.
drew_se: I'll add a small clinical fuzz set (abbrev expansion, drug names) to detect subtle tokenization drift. If mismatch appears we can propose either a fingerprinted tokenizer export or an fp16 canary for the POC.
morgan_compliance: Also flagging: AtlasCare requested SOC2 artifact checklist in the next 24h. I can prepare a one-pager to attach under NDA.
elena_sales: Great. I'll request their .spm and sample prompts now and send draft POC quote saying "quant tier + Private infra surcharge + 10 support hours" and note potential discount for trial. Will update after RINF-11824 results. :thumbsup:
